column1: Purpose: Log and keep track of how much newsletter you're sending out every day and week, and what topic they're on.
1. These columns are a starting point. Add or remove columns to match what you actually track. Don't touch the Dashboard's formulas unless you update what they point to.
2. Log one row every time you send something out.
3. Pick the Content Type from the dropdown, the Title/Subject line of the email or Description and the URL and set quantity.
4. Pull this data automatically if you can, your email platform's API, Zapier, or a scraper. Otherwise update it manually at least once a day.
